description: This file defines an interface for user settings management in the WPEFramework. It includes method declarations for setting and getting user preferences such as audio description, preferred languages, captions, closed caption service, and privacy mode. It also defines a nested notification interface for change events.

classes.name: IUserSettings
classes.description: An interface for managing user settings related to audio, video, captions, and privacy within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: A nested interface for notifications about user setting changes, including audio description, language preferences, captions, closed caption service, and privacy mode.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback object for user setting change events.

methods.name: SetAudioDescription
methods.description: Enables or disables the Audio Description setting.

methods.name: GetAudioDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the Audio Description setting.

methods.name: SetPreferredAudioLanguages
methods.description: Sets the preferred audio languages in ISO 639-2/B codes.

methods.name: GetPreferredAudioLanguages
methods.description: Gets the current preferred audio languages.

methods.name: SetPresentationLanguage
methods.description: Sets the presentation language in BCP 47 format.

methods.name: GetPresentationLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the current presentation language setting.

methods.name: GetPreferredCaptionsLanguages
methods.description: Gets the current preferred captions languages.

methods.name: SetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Sets the preferred closed captioning service.

methods.name: GetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Gets the current preferred closed captioning service.

methods.name: SetPrivacyMode
methods.description: Sets the privacy mode, e.g., share or do not share.

ctags.name: INotification
ctags.pattern: /^  struct EXTERNAL INotification : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
